svg.text: Future vision: OS vendor (openSUSE) supplies UKI + ISO directly; users skip this step
• SHA-512, size and volume label of the ISO
• modules: libnvdimm nd_e820 isofs squashfs tpm
+ nd_pmem / nd_btt (from the ISO's kernel RPM)
The kernel (init/initramfs.c) unpacks concatenated cpio archives, each with its own compression,
in order; later files overlay earlier ones. Same mechanism that loads early microcode.
Original stays a byte-identical prefix (cmp-checked); /bin /sbin /lib symlinks are never touched.
Same for all devices of this type
Future: supplied by OS vendor directly
Specific to each device being onboarded
lets both stages run TO1 → TO2; no address baked into the UKI
ed25519 / ecdsa / rsa public keys + device IP
→ known_hosts for a verified first connection
TO1 (to1d verified) → TO2 with TPM credential; voucher chain and owner signature verified
← BMO FSIM: UKI (125 MiB, ~2,000 rounds, SHA-256 checked)
then chainloads it via LoadImage / StartImage
← the untouched vendor initrd + appended overlay from above
dracut-cmdline root=live:LABEL=Install-Leap-16.0-x86_64 (baked into the initrd); Agama hook records the inst.* options
nm-initrd → nm-wait-online-initrd NetworkManager DHCP (ip=dhcp rd.neednet=1); kernel creates /dev/pmem0 from memmap=
1. Load libnvdimm / nd_e820 + appended nd_btt / nd_pmem; wait for /dev/tpmrm0 and /dev/pmem0 (4.2 GiB above 4 GiB)
2. Generate SSH host keys → /run/fdo/ssh-host-keys (Go crypto, no ssh-keygen); capture device IP
3. go-fdo-endpoint: TO1 → TO2 with credential reuse (owner address from the TPM credential's RV info)
→ Credentials FSIM: SSH public keys + IP
← Payload FSIM: full offline ISO (4.2 GiB) streamed → /dev/pmem0
← = server to device → = device to server
4. Verify /dev/pmem0 is ISO9660 with label Install-Leap-16.0-x86_64 (else emergency shell)
5. No hand-off code: inst.auto=file:///run/fdo/agama/profile.json is already on the cmdline
→ Agama's dracut hook saved it to /run/agama/cmdline.d; agama-autoinstall reads the file after switch_root
dracut-initqueue dmsquash-live mounts the ISO on /dev/pmem0 and LiveOS/squashfs.img as the live root (rd.retry starts only now)
switch_root into the Agama live system; /run is carried over (profile.json, ssh-host-keys); medium at /run/initramfs/live
storage: biggest disk > 16 GiB (never pmem*, never the small FDO EFI disk); product default btrfs + swap
Packages come from /run/initramfs/live/install on /dev/pmem0 — offline, nothing from the network
post script (chroot): 0600/0644 + restorecon, user key, NOPASSWD sudo, key-only sshd, drop installer-only kernel args
FDO-provisioned SSH host keys (no TOFU) • SELinux enforcing • configured via Agama profile
No cloud-init; ssh-keygen -A only creates missing keys • Server holds the public keys for verified first SSH
